sentence: When someone starts a project and needs a name or a logo but has no designer, they ask their AI agent and choose, step by step in their browser, among names that come with their meaning and logos that were tested before they see them, instead of settling for a generic drawing.

shows: identity card with light and dark lockups

sections.heading: Every option has an idea behind it

picture.claim: Each logo option comes from the name, from what the project does, or from both, and carries its own short story.
You choose and confirm in the browser while your agent draws, measures and reviews the next options, and the page moves on by itself.
The same skill installs in Claude Code as a plugin and with npx in Codex, Gemini or any other agent.
shows: claude code row with claude logo
other agent row with robot icon

logos.why: Claude, Codex and Gemini in their official colours, as the user asked; flat colour marks beside the solid geometric Kothar mark

icons.why: solid filled glyphs match the solid L-and-dot mark; a robot for any other agent
